stations.name: Toryn's Forge
stations.description: The largest public forge in Coldforge. Heat is included; coal is not.

stations.name: Karis's Apothecary
stations.description: Smells, oddly, of mint. Karis denies adding mint.

stations.name: Empath Abbey Carpentry
stations.description: Run by druids. Wood is given freely if your purpose pleases them.

stations.name: Lyceum Loom
stations.description: An old loom magically rethreaded each dawn.

stations.name: Common Workbench
stations.description: Found in nearly every town. Useful for trivial crafts.

stations.name: Castle Kitchens
stations.description: Lord Avermere's cooks tolerate amateur visits before noon.
